title: Contact CAS Development — Kyiv, Ukraine
description: Contact CAS Development: +380 97 866 77 55 (phone, WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber), 44 Antonovycha St., Kyiv. Free phone consultation.
lead: Tell us about your property and we will suggest a solution for your style and budget. The phone consultation is free; only a phone number is required in the form.

hero_img.alt: Hoda Estate house in the Carpathians — a CAS Development project

sections.p: Write to us at any time — we reply shortly.
rows: The same number works in Telegram, Viber and WhatsApp

sections.h2: Want to know the budget in advance?
p: Design from $30/m², renovation from $550/m², offices from $350/m², construction from $600/m², furnishing from $250/m². The final figure comes with the estimate after the consultation.
We work under a contract with an estimate and acceptance certificates for each stage; the warranty on works is 12 months; payment follows a schedule that suits you, starting from a 10% advance.
The CAS Development office is at 44 Antonovycha St., Kyiv. We work across Kyiv and the Kyiv region; renovation and construction are available in all regions of Ukraine and in Europe.
Since 2016 — 150+ projects in Kyiv, across Ukraine and abroad: in Spain, France, Germany, Poland, Turkey (Bodrum), the USA and Bali. The on-site survey is paid; the cost depends on the property.
